mapper.select:
select
from meeting_user_real_record where activity_id = #{activityId} order by id asc

select count(*) as total_count, round(avg(ifnull(answer_score_total, 0)), 1) as avg_answer_score, round(avg(least(ifnull(watch_duration, 0), #{attendanceDuration})), 1) as avg_watch_duration, round(avg(ifnull(join_flag, 0)) * 100.0, 1) as join_rate, round(avg(ifnull(answer_flag, 0)) * 100.0, 1) as answer_rate, round(avg(ifnull(answer_score_total, 0)) * 100.0 / #{answerScore}, 1) as answer_accuracy, round(avg(least(ifnull(watch_duration, 0), #{attendanceDuration})) * 100.0 / #{attendanceDuration}, 1) as watch_rate from meeting_user_real_record where activity_id = #{activityId} and team_name = #{teamName}
